dedupe_keys.name: fema resilience analysis and planning tool rapt

description: The Resilience Analysis and Planning Tool is FEMA's free web GIS that lets state, local, tribal and territorial officials and the public combine data on population, infrastructure and hazards to understand disaster impacts and resilience challenges in their communities. It has more than 100 preloaded layers, including the Community Resilience Challenges Index indicators, infrastructure locations, live weather and hazard layers, and the National Risk Index, whose version 1.20 data are loaded, with analysis tools that extend local GIS capacity. FEMA maintains it, with a resource centre, user guide, annual updates of indicator tables and correlation analysis, and a methodology for the Community Resilience Challenges Index based on indicators from peer-reviewed research published from 2003 to 2021; the page was updated in August 2026. Coverage is the United States. Format and access: a public web application with downloadable supporting documents. Licence: US federal data; free. Caveats: indicators are county or tract averages and layers vary in date. It supports hazard exposure, emergency response and resilience screening for US communities and lifelines. Related catalogue records are the FEMA National Risk Index and the FEMA ESF#6 shelter system.
